name: hcm-graph
description: HCM Graph — Core-HR slice (npm workspace root). server = tRPC API over Neo4j; web = React Router 7 UI; e2e = Playwright + axe accessibility evidence.

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run seed && npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hcm/server && npm run typecheck -w @hcm/web && npm run typecheck -w @hcm/e2e
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hcm/server && npm run test -w @hcm/web
